environment.configuration: 2D Release, normal engine/game -O2, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING OFF, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF, mold linker
environment.build_workers_and_affinity: Four workers pinned to logical CPUs 0,2,4,6 (one thread per performance core)
environment.host_activity: Not isolated. A separate workload drove observed load above 140 (observations up to about 199) during original GCC run 2. Host activity varied across phases; absolute times and ratios are exploratory.

implementation.scene_header: Forward-declare App, Input, InputActionContext, Renderer2D and Window; remove concrete platform/renderer includes.
implementation.scripting_header: Use core/types.hpp and renderer/color.hpp instead of scene.hpp; forward-declare borrowed service/context types and include string_view explicitly.
implementation.consumers: Add direct App includes to script_engine.cpp/script_scene.cpp and Input to lua_runtime_tests.cpp. Other Kin sources passed the dependency audit without additional include changes.
implementation.contracts: Two single-include C++ translation units compile the public headers independently, with component definitions, C++23, DISABLE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS=ON and UNITY_BUILD=OFF.
implementation.source_compatibility: Consumers outside the repository that relied on service definitions from these headers may need direct App/Input/Window/Renderer2D/scene.hpp includes. Class fields and method signatures/bodies are unchanged.

plan_method.method: Temporarily append a trailing comment to one header, then run Ninja -n against a copy of build.ninja in the same existing build directory. The alternate manifest filename avoids dry-run manifest regeneration stopping at CMake glob verification; all original rules and dependency data are retained. Restore original bytes and nanosecond timestamps after each header.
plan_method.cleanliness: Each compiler build was up to date for all three targets before collecting plans.
plan_method.real_build_cross_check: Every real timed App-edit build produced exactly the same object set as its corresponding plan.

timing_method.scope: Append a comment to platform/app.hpp and build hex_demo, including affected source compilations, the game PCH, two runtime archives and final game link. Other objects/dependencies/shaders and engine PCHs prebuilt.
timing_method.timer: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
timing_method.samples: Three per compiler before and three after. Compiler order alternates each round; the changed phase reverses the initial compiler order.
timing_method.version_order: All original-version samples completed before applying the cleanup. Changed-version samples followed successful builds and syntax/functional validation. Versions were not interleaved.
timing_method.source_restoration: After each timed edit, restore original header bytes and timestamps. After all timing, explicitly rebuild each compiler's hex_demo PCH against the restored header so its recorded sizes/timestamps match.
timing_method.memory: GNU time maximum child RSS; not simultaneous aggregate compiler memory.
timing_method.contended_sample: Original GCC run 2 took 118.38 s under heavy external CPU load and is retained in all summaries.

initial_syntax_findings.reason: Instantiating Input depended on an indirect include from ScriptEngine/Scene. Fixed by including kin/platform/input.hpp directly.

limits: Exact rebuild counts apply to the recorded targets/configurations. App edits show the largest structural reduction; Input/Window/Renderer2D reductions are smaller.
Wall comparisons are shared-host, before-then-after estimates, not isolated causal measurements. The contended GCC baseline sample was retained.
No whole-build, ordinary game-source edit, FPS or runtime performance speedup is claimed. Code remains normally optimized.
Public class layouts and method bodies are preserved, but consumers relying on transitive service includes may need explicit headers.
3D coverage is syntax/template compilation only. No Windows/MSVC or full 3D runtime validation in this round.

steps: Create an isolated worktree at base_commit, persistent GCC/Clang build directories, and configure as recorded. Prebuild hex_demo, shapes_demo and kin_lua. Adjust paths in embedded scripts and choose a TMPDIR with sufficient space.
Before applying the cleanup, run header_fanout.py before and header_measure.py before. The original baseline fixture must use the original headers.

Apply the include/forward-declaration cleanup and standalone header checks. Run header_syntax.py clang, repair any exposed consumer dependencies, then run header_syntax.py gcc clang-3d. The recorded run also reran the corrected Clang source and two new header checks using KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY.
Run header_validate.py, collecting the four baseline API reports used as its references from an optimized baseline build. Build the final standalone header target with its component definitions.
After syntax checks and validation builds finish, run header_fanout.py after and header_measure.py after, with no other agent-owned compile work running during timing.
Run header_restore.py, header_mechanical.py, verify clean source restoration and retain all samples, including contended ones.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,shlex,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-header-deps-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-header-deps-tmp')};selected=sys.argv[1:] or ['clang','gcc','clang-3d'];tasks=[]
for mode in selected:
 build=base/{'clang':'kin-build-time-clang','gcc':'kin-build-time-out','clang-3d':'kin-build-time-3d-clang'}[mode]
 for entry in json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text()):
  source=pathlib.Path(entry['file'])
  if source.suffix!='.cpp' or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(repo):continue
  only=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY','').split(',')))
  if only and str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo)) not in only:continue
  args=shlex.split(entry['command']);cmd=[];i=0
  while i<len(args):
   if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
   if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
   if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
   if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
   cmd.append(args[i]);i+=1
  cmd.append('-fsyntax-only');relative=str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo));tasks.append((mode,build,relative,cmd))
# Report production errors before tests to speed up dependency repairs.
tasks.sort(key=lambda t:('/tests/' in '/'+t[2],t[0],t[2]))
def check(task):
 mode,build,relative,cmd=task;log=out/('syntax-'+mode+'-'+relative.replace('/','_')+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=build,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'configuration':mode,'source':relative,'exit_code':r.returncode,'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pch':False}
 if r.returncode:print('FAIL '+mode+' '+relative+'\n'+log.read_text()[:5000],flush=True)
 return row
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(check,t) for t in tasks]):
  rows.append(future.result());(out/('syntax-results-'+'-'.join(selected)+('-targeted' if os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY') else '')+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'failures':sum(r['exit_code']!=0 for r in rows)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(r['exit_code'] for r in rows))
